events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 suffer their heaviest Premier League defeat yet when they lose 4–1 to 토트넘 홋스퍼 at White Hart Lane. They are still four points behind 뉴캐슬 유나이티드, but 케빈 키건 's team have two games in hand. 리버풀 muscle in on the top two with a 4–2 home win over 노팅엄 포리스트. Bolton remain rooted to the bottom of the table with a 4–2 defeat at 셰필드 웬즈데이.
Roy McFarland is sacked as co-manager of 볼턴 원더러스, with Colin Todd being put in sole charge. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 regain a seven-point by defeating 아스널 2–0 at home.

Ian Rush breaks Denis Law 's FA Cup goal-scoring record with two goals for 리버풀 in their 7–0 win over 로치데일 in the third round. An 80th-minute goal by Eric Cantona forces a 2–2 draw for 맨체스터 유나이티드 against 선덜랜드 at Old Trafford, taking the tie to a replay at Roker Park , in what could potentially be the old stadium's final FA Cup game, as 선덜랜드's new stadium at Monkwearmouth is expected to be completed in 18 months time.
Terry Venables announces that he will resign as England manager after Euro 96 to concentrate on clearing his name in a legal dispute with Alan Sugar over his June 1993 dismissal from 토트넘 홋스퍼.

맨체스터 유나이티드's title hopes are hit hard when they drop two points at home to 애스턴 빌라, who hold them to a goalless draw. Their neighbours City are pushed deeper into relegation trouble with a 1–0 defeat at 토트넘 홋스퍼, who move into third place. Down in Division One, Huddersfield boost their hopes of a second successive promotion with a 1–0 win at struggling 왓퍼드 lifting them into second place. The Black Country derby ends in a goalless draw at the Hawthorns, with both 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and Albion on the brink of the relegation zone.

뉴캐슬 유나이티드 are now nine points ahead with a game in hand at the top of the Premier League with a 1–0 win at Coventry. Charlton go second in Division One with a thrilling 4–3 away win over Birmingham, whose own promotion hopes are hit hard as a result.
Bryan Robson , 미들즈브러 manager and England assistant manager, is reportedly in line to succeed Terry Venables as England manager after Euro 96.

선덜랜드 take the lead against 맨체스터 유나이티드 in the FA Cup third round replay at Roker Park before Nicky Butt equalises and Andy Cole scores a late winner to give 알렉스 퍼거슨's team a 2–1 win and a fourth round clash with Reading at Elm Park .
In the FA Cup third round, 셰필드 유나이티드 eliminate 아스널 with a 1-0 replay win at Bramall Lane in which Carl Veart scores the winning goal.

Neil Ruddock and Robbie Fowler score twice each in 리버풀's 5–0 home win over 리즈 유나이티드 in the league. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 beat 볼턴 원더러스 2–1 to go 12 points clear at the top of the table, ahead of 리버풀 and 맨체스터 유나이티드.

Despite being reduced to 10 men after Nicky Butt was sent off, 맨체스터 유나이티드 still manage a 1–0 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Upton Park (where they last won seven years ago) thanks to an Eric Cantona goal which cuts 뉴캐슬 유나이티드's lead to nine points, although the Tynesiders still have a game in hand.
블랙번 로버스 block a move by the Irish Football Association to appoint their director of football, 케니 달글리시 , as the national coach.
Out-of-favour 리버풀 striker Nigel Clough is sold to 맨체스터 시티 for £1.5 million.
맨체스터 유나이티드 defeat Reading 3–0 in the FA Cup fourth round at Elm Park on a weekend where most league and cup fixtures are cancelled due to heavy snow.

January ends with 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 still ahead of 맨체스터 유나이티드 at the top of the Premier League by nine points, with a game in hand. 맨체스터 유나이티드 sign 맨체스터 시티 goalkeeper Tony Coton for £500,000 as cover for Peter Schmeichel . 더비 카운티 are top of Division One, with 찰턴 애슬레틱 second. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 are in danger of relegation less than three months after being among the leading promotion contenders, a goal away from the bottom three.
